w9Email.subject: W-9 needed for {{company}}
w9Email.bodyFull:
Hi {{vendor}},

For year-end 1099 reporting we need a current Form W-9 on file. Please upload yours via the secure link below — no account needed:

{{url}}

If you don't have a blank W-9 handy, download one at
https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/fw9.pdf

The link is good for 30 days and is single-use.

Thanks!

ninetyNine.title: 1099 prep
ninetyNine.intro: Year-end summary of payments to 1099-NEC contractors. The IRS threshold is $600 for the tax year — vendors at or above that need a 1099-NEC. Mark a vendor as 1099 in the Vendors tab and they'll appear here automatically. Tax IDs are required to file; rows missing one are flagged in red.
ninetyNine.emptyBelowThreshold: No 1099-flagged vendors hit the $600 threshold in {{year}} (toggle "Hide vendors below $600" to see all).
ninetyNine.footerPost: on any vendor to download Copies B (recipient) + C (payer) as PDFs. Copy A must be e-filed via the IRS FIRE system or printed onto the official red-ink scannable form.

merge.title: Merge duplicate {{plural}}
merge.subtitle: Pick the duplicate to discard ("loser") and the one to keep ("winner"). All of the loser's invoices, payments, bills, time entries, and recurring templates transfer to the winner; then the loser is deleted. Irreversible.
merge.confirmPrompt: This is irreversible. Type {{name}} below to confirm.
